description: This file is a shell script for testing the integration of git with Perforce (p4), focusing on handling filenames with shell metacharacters. It contains test cases that create, modify, and delete files with special characters in their names, as well as branch creation involving special characters.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts a Perforce server daemon for testing purposes.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleans up Git repositories created during testing.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository for testing.
